Conditions under which a rule applies

Source: R/setbacks.R
conditions.Rd

Attach to any setback (or other rule) with its when argument. All the conditions given must hold. A condition the engine cannot evaluate, because the layer it needs was not supplied, is not applied, and is counted and reported with the direction of the error it causes.

Usage

conditions(
  min_site_area = NULL,
  max_site_area = NULL,
  rear_sites = NULL,
  corner_sites = NULL,
  within_frontage = NULL,
  beyond_frontage = NULL,
  frontage_depth_share = NULL,
  adjacent_zones = NULL,
  not_adjacent_zones = NULL,
  facing = NULL,
  min_road_width = NULL,
  max_road_width = NULL,
  min_slope = NULL,
  max_slope = NULL,
  distance_to = NULL,
  min_distance = NULL,
  max_distance = NULL
)

Arguments

min_site_area, max_site_area

Site area bounds (m2).

rear_sites

"include" (default), "exclude" or "only".

corner_sites

"include" (default), "exclude" or "only".

within_frontage, beyond_frontage

Applies only to boundary segments whose midpoint is within, or beyond, this distance (m) of the road frontage.

frontage_depth_share

Applies only beyond this share of site depth from the frontage (e.g. Christchurch's "front 60 per cent" exemption is 0.6).

adjacent_zones, not_adjacent_zones

Zone keys or family names across the boundary that make the rule apply, or that stop it applying.

facing

Bearing range c(from, to) of the boundary's outward normal (degrees clockwise from north) for the rule to apply. A rule for "a site on the southern boundary of its neighbour" faces north: c(315, 45).

min_road_width, max_road_width

Road reserve width bounds (m).

min_slope, max_slope

Site slope bounds (per cent).

distance_to

Name of a layer, with min_distance / max_distance, for rules that apply within a distance of a feature (e.g. a station).

min_distance, max_distance

Distance bounds (m) to distance_to.

Value

A list with class plancap_conditions.

Examples

conditions(adjacent_zones = "RES_ANY", min_site_area = 1000)
#> $min_site_area
#> [1] 1000
#> 
#> $adjacent_zones
#> [1] "RES_ANY"
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "plancap_conditions"
conditions(distance_to = "transit", max_distance = 800)
#> $distance_to
#> [1] "transit"
#> 
#> $max_distance
#> [1] 800
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "plancap_conditions"
